newsitem.title: USA: Clear Channel to buy Eller Media.
newsitem.headline: Clear Channel to buy Eller Media.

text.p: Clear Channel Communications Inc, a diversified broadcasting company, said Wednesday it had agreed to acquire outdoor advertising firm Eller Media Corp for $1.15 billion in cash and stock.
Clear Channel said it will pay about $750 million in cash and $400 million in stock.
Eller Media Corp is the holding company of Eller Media Co.
Eller Media, which has over 50,000 billboards in 15 major markets, will operate as an autonomous unit of Clear Channel, Clear Channel said.
"This acquisition gives the company a leading presence in the dynamic outdoor advertising industry," said Lowry Mays, chairman of Clear Channel.

"The out-of-home advertising sector continues to grow and this acquisition will enhance our ability to take advantage of this advertising trend. Outdoor advertising has exhibited strong, consistent top-line growth coupled with high operating margins resulting in significant free cash flow," Mays said.

Karl Eller, chairman and chief executive of Eller Media Co, will remain chief executive and will join the Clear Channel board. Karl Eller and the rest of Eller Media's management team will remain in place and will keep a "significant portion" of proceeds in Clear Channel stock, Clear Channel said.
Clear Channel did not provide further details.
The deal is subject to certain regulatory approvals and other closing conditions.
Clear Channel said it was represented in the deal by Daniels & Associates, while Eller Media was represented by Alex. Brown & Sons.
Gruntal & Co said in a research report it expects the deal will be slightly dilutive to earnings.
Gruntal said it would provide additional details after a teleconference with Clear Channel today.
Gruntal said it continues to recommend purchase of Clear Channel for long-term investment purposes.
